segments.name: Work Marketplace
segments.description: Operates the Upwork Marketplace and Lifted platform connecting businesses with independent talent and enterprise workforce solutions for clients worldwide.
segments.evidence: We operate our business as one operating and reportable segment.

revenueModel.text: Talent pay service fees on their billings and clients pay marketplace fees on payments to talent; Lifted enterprise clients pay subscriptions, service fees and managed services.
revenueModel.evidence: Revenue is primarily derived through the Upwork Marketplace, which charges fees to talent as a percentage of their billings to clients, which we refer to as talent service fees, and fees to clients as a percentage of payment to talent, which we refer to as client marketplace fees.
